description:
Details of one listing: facts, Somantic's valuation, and the link to the
original.

No description text: it is the advertiser's, at source_url. A withdrawn
(inactive) listing is not returned: the call fails with "No listing", since
the offer no longer exists.

`image_urls` is always empty: Somantic passes on no photos. They are the
advertiser's, at source_url.

property.description: "wohnung" or "haus" if known; both are tried otherwise.

name: get_listing
title: Get listing
